label: Distribution modeling approach
purpose: Model the physical terminal distribution in vol-standardized log-moneyness; distribution-regression challenger; drop fixed bins

label: Distribution evaluation metrics
purpose: Primary score: threshold-weighted CRPS with weight 1 on |z| in [0.5, 2.5] tapering to 0.25 at z=0 and |z|>=3, with full-distribution CRPS beside it; Brier and reliability at the listed strikes; PIT/Berkowitz in the tails; only proper weighted scores; never choose the evaluation subset by outcomes. Strike regions are a pooled decomposition, never a cell axis. Predictability only: no P&L or strategy economics

label: Procedural windows
purpose: Development 2017-01-03..2019-12-31 (fit plus last cal_n origins as early-stop band); validation 2020-01-02..2023-12-31 reported also by sub-period; holdout 2024-01-02..2025-11-28 sealed and opened once for promoted recipes; 2026 sealed forever; a row is on the earlier side of any boundary only if its label settles before it (label_reaches)

label: Fold rungs
purpose: Screen: warm-up fold (train 2017-2018, validate 2019; timing and learning curves only, never ranked) plus one scored fit trained through 2019 and scored 2020-2023. Promotion: quarterly expanding refits for each quarter of 2020-2023 with seeds 11/29/47. Holdout: quarterly expanding refits for each quarter of 2024-2025 on the same recipe, one opening (owner decision 2026-11-04, replacing yearly refits and the single fit through 2023)

label: Promotion rule and uncertainty
purpose: Eligible only if paired CRPS skill vs horizon_empirical and vs the market-implied reference is above zero on the full validation window and in at least 3 of 4 years; two-way cluster-robust intervals (expiry and symbol); never the best cell by score

label: Cell definition
purpose: Cell = (ticker, expiry rank). Weekly names: ranks 1-8, rank k = the k-th listed Friday expiry (the 7-day windows 1-7, 8-14, ...). Monthly-only names: expiry position 1-3, per ticker but flagged underpowered, with a pooled monthly line beside them. Thursday holiday expiries stay

label: Eligibility gate
purpose: Simple: a cell passes if the model beats the raw market-implied distribution AND the per-name horizon baseline on the A0002 score in at least 3 of 4 yearly folds and at least 3 of 5 regimes (S0 pre-crash, S1 covid crash, S2 recovery, S3 rate shock, S4 2023). No multiplicity correction yet: report the number passing next to the number expected by luck. The recalibrated market and the pooled baseline join when built

label: Training sequence and run
purpose: Retrain periodically for all events: quarterly expanding retrains, each of 2019Q4 and 2020Q1-2023Q4 trained on all mature history before that quarter starts, weights fixed within the quarter. Locked recipe (owner 2026-11-05): fixed_loc on the locked ticker list (A0009), learning rate 1e-4, dropout 0.11, weight decay 0.045, hidden 64, width 8, 6 epochs, no per-fit epoch selection, seeds 11/29/47/53/71 averaged by linear pool; recipe SHA-256 b10d67deebb5be51fd2dd7fcf2a5f527c28aa7a84cd39ebc3ecd3a503e9e6bdc. Chosen by the full-span zoo (2020-2023, all passed A0005), then 135 Bayesian HPO trials and the follow-up 15-cell grid, tuned on 2019. Forecasts for all 17 quarters are produced, pinned and scored; a 2020Q1 rerun reproduced them hash for hash on the WSL GPU; 2019Q4 is the tuned year, not a test. Scores unread by agents. 2024-2025 forecasts are on hold and sealed (owner 2026-11-05). Supersedes the M53 recipe locked 2026-11-04 and A0004's screen rung.

label: Locked ticker list
purpose: The one ticker list for every new fit, forecast and MIO run: 166 names, SHA-256 8eae0a07fe2bc667e597476f00909359d12c57c6d180f3f2d954e1b907fbc90e. Rule uses dates and input presence only (full span 2017-01-03..2025-12-31, at most 5 sessions missing, complete bars and liquidity, identity check, at least 40 market-eligible rows in 2017-2019). Any change needs an owner decision and a logged reason (owner 2026-11-04: lock the ticker list so that this does not happen again; only full-span tickers). Survival bias remains and is unmeasured

label: MIO test plan
purpose: MIO test plan through 2023 only; no MIO on 2024 onward (owner 2026-11-05). Forecasts: the tuned fixed_loc model, 5 seeds, hash-pinned, no one views them. Selection: nine formulations (w1_010_shock10_lp, w1_003_shock10_lp, w1_003_shock10_mad050_lp, nominal_lp as control, w1_010z_shock10_lp, w1_010_shock10_fine_lp, w1_010_component25_shock10_lp, w1_010_name25_shock10_lp, w1_010_shock05_book_lp) on four quarters: 2019Q4, 2020Q1, 2021Q1, 2021Q2. The owner reviews those results and picks the top 3. Those 3 then run on 2022 and 2023, 8 quarters, unopened until the picks are fixed. Total 60 separate accounts. Execution: each quarter-arm has its own registry; Mac and WSL workers solve single methods; trust the Mac's answer with no routine re-solve, WSL recalculates values and refuses invalid results, and one first-unit similarity check at 1% runs before scaling up; optimality is not independently verified. Mac workers may use a RAM disk and never its SSD. Results are development evidence: past results and the model selection overlap these years, and only 2024 onward is clean. Owner 2026-11-05: the Mac is certified by a short worker check on a 1-2 week packet with no exact match; a WSL rejection stops new Mac units as soon as it is logged and is never silent; while 2022-2023 stay unopened a rejection shows unit, check name and count only. The four formulations w1_010_shock10_lp, w1_003_shock10_lp, w1_003_shock10_mad050_lp and nominal_lp run first as plain WSL documents on the four selection quarters; machine does not matter for comparing results
